value.rationale: This is a complete classification at the minimal market where a canonical mechanism loses full strategyproofness. Exact incidence, orbit structure, unique reports, and one universal utility cone sharpen a classical existential counterexample into a reusable boundary theorem, which is mathematically and economically motivated.

final_claim: For probabilistic serial, full stochastic-dominance strategyproofness holds in the 2-by-2 market and first fails in the strict 3-by-3 market on exactly 54 of 216 profiles and 72 agent-profile pairs; every vulnerable agent has one violating top-two-swap report, the events form two symmetry types, all have lottery change \((-1/4,1/3,-1/12)\), and profitability is exactly \(4M>3T+B\).
limitations: The complete census is only for strict 3-by-3 markets; no larger-market frequency theorem is claimed.
